questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 20 ÷ 20 + 20 – 25 × 25 = 419
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

20 ÷ 20 + 20 – 25 × 25 = 419
questions.solution:
Given equation :-20 ÷ 20 + 20 – 25 × 25 = 419

1) Interchanging + and -,

Equation will become :- 20 ÷ 20 - 20 + 25 × 25

= 1 – 20 + 625

≠ 419

2) Interchanging + and ÷

Equation will become :- 20 + 20 ÷ 20 – 25 × 25

20 + 1 – 625

≠ 419

3) Interchanging × and –

Equation will become :- 20 ÷ 20 + 20 × 25 - 25

= 1 + 500 - 25

≠ 419

4) Interchanging ÷ and ×

Equation will become :- 20 × 20 + 20 – 25 ÷ 25

= 400 + 20 – 1

= 419

Thus, interchanging “÷ and ×” we get the correct answer.

questions.question: Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: No grass is a flower. All flowers are trees. Conclusions: I. Some trees are flowers. II. Some trees are grasses. III. No trees is a grass.
questions.questionHtml:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No grass is a flower.

All flowers are trees.

Conclusions:

I. Some trees are flowers.

II. Some trees are grasses.

III. No trees is a grass.

options.text: Either conclusion II or III follows
options.html: Either conclusion II or III follows

options.text: Either conclusions II or III, and I follow
options.html: Either conclusions II or III, and I follow

questions.solution:
Statement I :No grass is a flower.

Statement II :All flowers are trees.

Conclusion I: Some trees are flowers → True

Conclusion II: Some trees are grasses → False(it is possible but not definite)

Conclusion III: No trees is a grass. → False(it is possible but not definite)

Here, Conclusion II and III makes complimentary pairs.

Hence, “Either conclusions II or III, and I follow” is the correct answer.

questions.question: If x + 1/x = 5, then x 3 + 1/x 3 is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If x + 1/x = 5, then x<sup>3</sup> + 1/x<sup>3</sup> is equal to:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

For an algebraic expression of the form x + 1/x = k, the value of x3 + 1/x3 is calculated as k3 − 3k.

Given that x + 1/x = 5, we have k = 5.

⇒ Value = 53 − 3 × 5

⇒ Value = 125 − 15 = 110.

∴ The correct answer is 110.

Alternate Method

Given:

x + 1/x = 5

Formula Used:

The algebraic identity for the cube of a binomial: (a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b)

Calculations:

Cubing both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (x + 1/x)3 = 53

⇒ x3 + (1/x)3 + 3 × x × (1/x) × (x + 1/x) = 125

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 + 3 × 1 × (x + 1/x) = 125

Substituting the value of (x + 1/x) = 5:

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 + 3(5) = 125

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 + 15 = 125

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 125 − 15

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 110

Therefore, the correct option is 3.

∴ The correct answer is 110.

Additional Information

Square Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 − 2.

Negative Sign Identity (Cube)

If x − 1/x = k, then x3 − 1/x3 = k3 + 3k.

Negative Sign Identity (Square)

If x − 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 + 2.

Higher Powers

To find x4 + 1/x4, square the result of x2 + 1/x2 and subtract 2.

questions.question: If (x – 5) 3 + (x – 6) 3 + (x – 7) 3 = 3(x – 5)(x – 6)(x – 7), then what is the value of x?
questions.questionHtml: If (x – 5)<sup>3</sup> + (x – 6)<sup>3</sup> + (x – 7)<sup>3</sup> = 3(x – 5)(x – 6)(x – 7), then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
⇒ (x – 5)3 + (x – 6)3 + (x – 7)3 = 3 (x – 5) (x – 6) (x – 7)

As we know, if x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = 0, then x + y + z = 0

⇒ (x – 5)3 + (x – 6)3 + (x – 7)3 = 3 (x – 5) (x – 6) (x –7)

⇒ (x – 5)3 + (x – 6)3 + (x – 7)3 – 3(x – 5) (x – 6) (x – 7) = 0

⇒ (x – 5) + (x – 6) + (x – 7) = 0

⇒ 3x – 18 = 0

⇒ x = 6

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is the diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 129°. Then, ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is the diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 129°. Then, ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, and ∠ADC = 129°

As we know, the sum of the either pair of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

⇒ ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° – 129° = 51°

In ΔACB, if AB is diameter, then ∠ACB = 90°

⇒ ∠ACB + ∠ABC + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ 90° + 51° + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° – 90° – 51° = 39°

questions.question: A starts walking at 4 kmph and after 4 hours, B starts cycling from the same point as that of A, in the same direction at 10 kmph. After how much distance from the starting point will B catch up with A (Correct to two decimal places)?
questions.questionHtml: A starts walking at 4 kmph and after 4 hours, B starts cycling from the same point as that of A, in the same direction at 10 kmph. After how much distance from the starting point will B catch up with A (Correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
Speed of A = 4 km/h

Distance covered by A in 4 hours = 4 × 4 = 16 km

Speed of B = 10 km/h

Time taken by B to catch up with A = 16/(10 – 4) = 16/6 = 8/3 hr

Total distance covered by B in 8/3 hrs = 10 × 8/3 = 80/3 = 26.67 km

questions.solution:
As we know, simple interest and compound interest of the first year are same.

Let the principal be Rs. 2,190 it will be in the next year Rs, 2,409

Principal = 2190 and time = 1 year and r = ?

Interest = 2409 – 2190 = 219

⇒ S.I = (P × r × t)/100

⇒ 219 = (2190 × r × 1)/100

⇒ r = 21900/2190 = 10%

questions.question: A earns Rs. 180 per hour and works for 7 hours per day. B earns Rs. 160 per hour and works for 5 hours per day. What is the ratio of the wages of A and B?

questions.solution:
A earns Rs. 180 per hour

Total earning of A if he works for 7 hours per day = 180 × 7 = 1260

B earns Rs. 160 per hour

Total earning of B if he works for 5 hours per day = 160 × 5 = 800

Ratio of the wages of A and B = 1260 : 800 = 63 : 40

questions.questionHtml: What is the difference between a single discount of 30% and a single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 5%, being given on shopping of Rs. 2,000?
questions.solution:
Short trick:

Single Successive equivalent discount of 25% and 5%

⇒ 25 + 5 – [(25 × 5)/100] = (30 – 1.25)%

Required difference between a single discount of 30% and single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 5% = 30% – (30 – 1.25)% = 30 – 30 + 1.25 = 1.25%

Required difference = Rs. 2000 × 1.25/100 = Rs. 25

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 50°. Its sides AB and AC are produced to the point D and E. If the bisectors of the ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at the point O, then ∠BOC will be equal to:

questions.solution:
The angle between the external bisectors of two angles of a triangle is difference between right angle and half of the third angle.

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – [∠A/2]

Given, ∠A = 50°

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – 50/2

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – 25° = 65°

questions.question: 3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 6 days. A woman does triple the work a man does and a boy does half the work a man does. How many women alone will be able to complete this work in 4 days?
questions.questionHtml: 3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 6 days. A woman does triple the work a man does and a boy does half the work a man does. How many women alone will be able to complete this work in 4 days?
questions.solution:
3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 6 days

According to the question

⇒ W = 3M

⇒ M : W = 1 : 3

⇒ B = M/2

⇒ M : B = 2 : 1

Efficiency of man, woman and boy (M : W : B) = 2 : 6 : 1

Total work = (3M + 4W + 6B) × 6

⇒ (3 × 2 + 4 × 6 + 6 × 1) × 6 = 216

Suppose x women alone can complete that work in 4 days, then

⇒ x × 6 × 4 = 216

⇒ x = 9 days

⇒ 2∠OAB = 180 – ∠AOB = 180° – 140° = 40°

⇒ ∠OAB = 20°

questions.question: If 3 cos 2 A + 7 sin 2 A = 4, then what is the value of cot A, given that A is an acute angle?

⇒ 3 cos2 A + 7 sin2 A = 4

⇒ 3 cos2A + 3 sin2 A + 4 sin2A = 4

⇒ 3(cos2A + sin2 A) + 4 sin2A = 4

⇒ 3 × 1 + 4 sin2 A = 4

⇒ 4 sin2A = 4 – 3 = 1

⇒ sin2A = 1/4

⇒ sin A = 1/2

⇒ sin A = sin 30°

⇒ A = 30°

⇒ cot A = cot 30° = √3

Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select No Improvement.

An old misunderstanding exists among the two families, so they are not friends any more.

options.text: will exist among the two families
options.html: will exist among the two families

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

Among is used when we are talking about more than two things.

Between is used when we are talking about 2 things.

So, here between should be used. So, option 3 is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. ATTRIBUTE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

ATTRIBUTE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2.

Attribute means a quality or feature regarded as a characteristic or inherent part of someone or something.

Speech means the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

Quality means a distinctive attribute or characteristic possessed by someone or something.

Praise means express warm approval or admiration of.

Respect means a feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities, qualities, or achievements.

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences, Select the option that gives their correct order. A. Once the formalities are done, you can start using your account and save time and money. B. Opening a bank account can seem intimidating. C. Getting your account opened is just a matter of providing certain details and funding your account. D. Fortunately, most banks follow a standardized process.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences, Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. Once the formalities are done, you can start using your account and save time and money.

B. Opening a bank account can seem intimidating.

C. Getting your account opened is just a matter of providing certain details and funding your account.

D. Fortunately, most banks follow a standardized process.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2.

First should be B as it gives an introduction of what is being talked about i.e how opening a bank account is intimidating. Next should be D as it is the statement contradicting B and describes how banks follow a standardized process. After D, it should be C as it shows how the account can be opened and C should be followed by A.

The sequence is :BDCA.

questions.question: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. The part of a country's government responsible for its legal system

The part of a country's government responsible for its legal system
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2.

Police mean the civil force of a state, responsible for the prevention and detection of crime and the maintenance of public order.

questions.question: In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error. Entering the hall, the show had started.
questions.questionHtml:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

Entering the hall, the show had started.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

Entering is in present continuous tense but the phrase had started is in past participle tense. So, option 3 contains an error. It should be --When  I entered.
